description.value: The Cod Squad is a fish and chips restaurant located in Nanaimo, BC, serving classic British-style fried seafood. As a takeout-style eatery in a coastal Vancouver Island city, it would likely appeal to cyclists looking for a satisfying, quick meal along the Nanaimo waterfront area.
